name: Ōgimi (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Ōgimi village emblem in yellow: a ring open at the hoist with a winged stroke at the top.
history: Municipal flag of Ōgimi, a village in Okinawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 January 1972.

features.role: Ōgimi village emblem — a ring open at the hoist with a winged stroke at the top
